dog.special_notes: Dogs need regular exercise and consistent routine. Energy level varies by breed.

cat.special_notes: Cats are independent. Respect quiet time but provide daily interaction.

bird.special_notes: Birds need social interaction and mental stimulation. Daily out-of-cage time is important.

rabbit.special_notes: Rabbits are social and need daily exercise. Keep routine consistent.

hamster.special_notes: Hamsters are nocturnal. Provide enrichment and safe spaces to burrow.

default.special_notes: Basic pet care for any animal.
